provenance: Provenance: real 1920x1080 HOI4 frames captured during live arena matches on 2026-09-19, copied unmodified from artifacts/ (which is gitignored) because they are the only evidence of these overlays. Hand-labelled from 5x nearest-neighbour crops and numpy pixel dumps; the frame top-left of each counter was confirmed against its org bar, which sits at +13,+13. Labels are one reader's judgement of the pixels, not game state: there is no save file for these frames, so organisation/strength are NOT labelled.
note: The live 'zero own counters' frame. Both own divisions are on screen and both were missed: Arena 9690 has a red combat skull over its top-left corner, Arena 6703 has the cream ring. The enemy counter at Budapest is behind a red battle arrow and was missed too. Only the clean enemy counter in Arena 3731 was found (1 of 4).

conventions.center: centre of the counter's 62x22 frame in image pixels (frame top-left + [31, 11])
conventions.match: a detection matches when its bbox centre is within 16 px horizontally and 8 px vertically and the relation agrees
conventions.visibility: full = whole counter visible; partial = a human can tell a counter is there (recall counts these); sliver = a few pixels, excluded from recall, a detection there is not a false positive
conventions.selected: the cream/gold ring is drawn round the frame. Read as the game's SELECTION highlight: each frame's province tooltip says 'Currently selected: Divisions: 1' and each frame has exactly one ringed counter. It is not an order marker -- in the two fix_advance frames both own divisions carry a movement chevron and only one is ringed.
conventions.overlay: extra art drawn over the counter that used to defeat detection: ring = the cream selection ring, skull = a red combat skull on the top-left corner, arrow = a red battle arrow reaching across the top-left corner, chevron = a '>>' movement badge at the right end
conventions.province: the province name the game printed above the counter, for traceability only; it is not used by any test
